name: live-score-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Live Score Update app containing backend and score-client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,client" -c "cyan,magenta" --kill-others "pnpm --dir backend dev" "wait-on tcp:5000 && pnpm --dir score-client dev"
scripts.dev:npm: concurrently -n "backend,client" -c "cyan,magenta" --kill-others "npm --prefix backend run dev" "wait-on tcp:5000 && npm --prefix score-client run dev"
